values.note: '2026: All sites are $45/night, weekday or weekend. 2027: All sites are $50/night, weekday or weekend.' A non-refundable 2.75% service fee applies to card payments.

fees.source: https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/rates.aspx ('2026: All sites are $45/night, weekday or weekend.', '2027: All sites are $50/night', 'Processing Fee: A non-refundable service fee of 2.75% will be applied to all card transactions'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/rates.aspx ('All sites offer Full Hookups with 20/30/50 amp electric.'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/ ('44 campsites that are newly refurbished with up-to-date amenities'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Rules mention 'restrooms and showers' and a 'sewage disposal site'. Picnic shelter (up to 50 people) for campground guests only. No wood-burning campfires; grills allowed.

facilities.source: https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/documents/CampgroundRulesRegulations.pdf ('Please keep our restrooms and showers neat and clean', 'except at sewage disposal site', 'NO WOOD BURNING campfires'), revised 12/11/2023, read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/ ('The 2026 season for the RV Campground is March 1st – December 5th.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve on Forsyth County's WebTrac site ('Reserve Now') or at 336-703-6494; full payment at booking. Up to 14 nights in any 30 days, then 14 days away before returning; 'not a long-term stay facility'. Check-in 1-8 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Must be 21 to reserve. Cancel within 14 days of arrival: one night's charge.

booking.source: https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/documents/CampgroundRulesRegulations.pdf ('Campground Reservations can be booked up to 365 days in advance', 'The maximum length of stay, cumulatively, is fourteen (14) days per 30-day period', 'Check In Time – No earlier than 1 p.m. to 8 p.m.', 'You must be at least 21 years of age to reserve a campsite') + https://rvcampground.tanglewoodpark.org/rates.aspx (payment and cancellation policy) + the site's 'Reserve Now' link to WebTrac, read 2026-10-22

note: Forsyth County-operated RV campground in 1,100-acre Tanglewood Park along the Yadkin River near Clemmons, secluded from the park's sports areas; golf, trails, horseback riding and the Festival of Lights in the park. RVs only: no tents or canopies. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 a night in 2026 ($50 in 2027), 44 full-hookup 20/30/50-amp sites, season Mar 1 - Dec 5 (2026); added showers/dump, WebTrac booking 365 days ahead, 14-night max. Note cleaned of hookups/site count/booking/season. Not stated on the county's pages: max rig length (55 ft, derived from the old note, left), pull-throughs, Wi-Fi (left); the WebTrac site list returned no units to a plain search.
